parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all three error targets: (1) it reclassifies the hedged theoretical remark as not an explicit action, fixing the factual error and rubric misapplication; (2) it removes the unsupported inference that authors know they should use more data, replacing it with the claim that authors have no meaningful guidance; (3) it removes the score-3 classification and instead refers to the lowest rubric level without naming a numeric score. Unrelated correct reasoning from the original is preserved, no new evidence is invented, and no numeric score or gold label is stated directly.
